tagline.zh: 把意图编译成可验证、可回滚的执行链
tagline.en: Compiling intent into verifiable, rollback-safe chains

summary.zh: 它不是一个 agent，也不是另一个 agent 框架。它是一层运行在 LLM 之上的 runtime：意图先被编译成带验收标准的 Plan DAG，副作用必须经过按风险分级的审批闸门，每一次回执都写进哈希链审计日志。换掉底下的 agent，这一层不变。
summary.en: Not an agent, and not another agent framework — a runtime layer above the LLM. Intent compiles into a Plan DAG with acceptance criteria, side effects pass a risk-tiered approval gate, and every receipt lands in a hash-chained audit log. Swap the agent underneath; this layer stays.

zh: 意图 → 结构化 Plan DAG，每个节点自带验收标准
副作用按风险分级审批，失败可回滚
哈希链审计日志：可验证、可重放、可封存
弹性改道，单步失败不会拖死整条链
en: Intent compiles into a Plan DAG where every node carries acceptance criteria
Risk-tiered approval gate for side effects, with rollback on failure
Hash-chained audit log — verifiable, replayable, sealable
Elastic rerouting so one failed step doesn't stall the whole run

tagline.zh: 用纯批处理按名字切换 JDK
tagline.en: Switching JDKs by name, in pure batch

summary.zh: 一个 java.bat 垫片拦截 PATH 上的 java，把它转发到你选中的 JDK。同一个终端里，两个项目可以跑在两套 JDK 上；JAVA_HOME 永远指向 JEnv 目录，jenv use / jenv local 立刻对读环境变量的工具生效。
summary.en: A java.bat shim intercepts java on PATH and forwards it to the JDK you picked — two projects, two JDKs, one terminal. JAVA_HOME always points at the JEnv directory, so jenv use / jenv local take effect immediately for tools that read it.

zh: 纯 cmd/batch 实现，不依赖 PowerShell
JAVA_HOME 恒指向 JEnv 目录，不再写死真实 JDK 路径
三份纯文本注册表文件，取代 JSON 配置
附带只读 MCP server，让 agent 查询当前 JDK
en: Pure cmd/batch implementation with no PowerShell dependency
JAVA_HOME always points at JEnv, never a hard-coded JDK path
Three plain-text registry files instead of JSON
A read-only MCP server so agents can query the active JDK

tagline.zh: 只锁一个不太可信的模型
tagline.en: A cage for one untrusted model

summary.zh: 一个 Claude Code 的 PreToolUse / PostToolUse hook：当前模型是 MiniMax 时启用硬拒绝、下载前询问、灰区 LLM 审计；换成别的模型直接 exit 0，零开销。
summary.en: A Claude Code PreToolUse / PostToolUse hook: hard-deny, ask before download, and an LLM auditor for the gray zone — but only when the active model is MiniMax. Any other model exits 0 at once.

zh: 机械硬拒绝：项目外删改、读 ~/.ssh ~/.aws、改注册表
不常见下载操作弹窗，交给人判断
独立审计模型给出 verdict + confidence + severity
置信度路由与会话记忆，减少弹窗疲劳
en: Mechanical hard deny: deletes outside the project, reads of ~/.ssh and ~/.aws, registry edits
Uncommon downloads raise a prompt instead of a guess
A separate auditor model returns verdict + confidence + severity
Confidence routing and session memo to fight popup fatigue

tagline.zh: 终端里的本地代码助手
tagline.en: A local coding assistant in your terminal

summary.zh: 用一句自然语言在终端里创建、查看、修改并运行 Python 文件，全程只连本机 Ollama，默认 qwen2.5-coder:3b。所有文件读写与执行都限制在 sandbox/ 目录内，越界路径直接拒绝。
summary.en: Create, read, edit and run Python files from a plain-language prompt. Everything talks to local Ollama only (qwen2.5-coder:3b by default), and file access is confined to sandbox/.

zh: 自然语言任务 → 工具调用 → 最终答案
/reset /quiet /tools 等 REPL 命令
路径越界直接拒绝，只动 sandbox/
断网可用，不产生云端费用
en: Plain-language task, tool calls, then a final answer
REPL commands like /reset, /quiet and /tools
Out-of-scope paths are refused; only sandbox/ is touched
Works offline and costs nothing in the cloud

tagline.zh: Android 上的 Markdown 编辑器

summary.zh: Flutter 搭界面，WebView 里跑 Milkdown，通过 Android SAF 读写文档；带最近文件、主题与字号设置，能接收系统文件关联，也能导出 DOCX、HTML 与 PDF。
summary.en: Flutter shell, Milkdown inside a WebView, Android SAF for file access — plus recents, themes, font size, file associations, and DOCX / HTML / PDF export.

zh: 保留 Android 文档 URI，打开、编辑、保存都不丢位置
代码块主题高亮、行号、折叠与复制
通过 Android 系统打印生成 PDF
GPL-3.0，中英日法四语 README
en: Keeps the Android document URI, so open–edit–save never loses its place
Themed code blocks with line numbers, folding and copy
PDF generated through Android system printing
GPL-3.0, with READMEs in Chinese, English, Japanese and French

tagline.zh: 给 agent 用的 OCR 工具服务
tagline.en: OCR as an MCP service for agents

summary.zh: 基于 PaddleOCR 的 MCP stdio server：文字、表格、手写、公式都能认，公式直接输出 LaTeX；输入支持本地路径和 HTTP(S) URL，pip install 之后就能接进 Claude Desktop。
summary.en: A PaddleOCR-backed MCP stdio server: text, tables, handwriting and formulas — with LaTeX output. Inputs can be local paths or HTTP(S) URLs, and one pip install plugs it into Claude Desktop.

zh: 四个工具：文字、表格、手写、公式识别
中英日韩多语言，默认中文
表格识别输出结构化文本
pip install ocr-mcp，stdio 直接跑
en: Four tools: text, table, handwriting and formula recognition
Chinese, English, Japanese and Korean, Chinese by default
Table recognition returns structured text
pip install ocr-mcp, then run over stdio

tagline.en: The site you are looking at

summary.zh: 零构建、零依赖的手写静态站：蜂窝式项目星图、Canvas 星场、中英切换，全部由原生 HTML/CSS/ES module 完成，没有一个外部库。
summary.en: A hand-written static site with no build step and no dependencies: a honeycomb project map, a Canvas starfield and zh/en switching, all in native HTML, CSS and ES modules.

zh: 无框架、无 CDN、无构建
滚轮锚点缩放、拖拽、捏合、双击复位
prefers-reduced-motion 下静态降级
Soul for U 原样保留在 /soul-for-u/
en: No framework, no CDN, no build
Anchor-point zoom, drag, pinch, double-click to reset
Static fallback under prefers-reduced-motion
Soul for U preserved untouched at /soul-for-u/

summary.zh: 代码之外的记录：想清楚的事、做坏的事、半夜想通的事。目前还是空的，空着也算一种状态。
summary.en: Notes beyond code: things thought through, things broken, things that clicked at 3 a.m. Empty for now — empty is also a state.

tagline.en: A page written for one person

summary.zh: 一个只为某个人存在的小房间：星光、一段信、几句悄悄话，配着能循环很久的音乐。它没有被改版，只是搬到了隔壁。
summary.en: A small room that exists for exactly one person: starlight, a letter, a few whispers, and music that loops for a long time. It wasn't redesigned — it just moved next door.
